summary: Array Technologies filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Affordable Wire Management (AWM) via subsidiary STINorland USA. Cash consideration was approximately $165 million, net of customary adjustments, under an equity purchase agreement dated July 16, 2026. The acquisition expands Array's balance-of-system strategy with AWM's high-margin cable management products for solar, energy storage, and datacenter applications. No advisors, premium, or break fee were disclosed. The deal closed on August 31, 2026, with final post-closing settlement pending. Watch for integration execution and revenue contribution from the new product line.
